title: Pneumatic-Tire Forklift with Extended Forks

onscreen_lines.desc: Furnish and deliver one (1) new, unused forklift meeting or exceeding the following minimum requirements: Rated lifting capacity: 5,000 pounds minimum Extended forks: 8 feet in length Engine: Diesel or gasoline-powered Tires: Solid pneumatic tires; air-filled tires will not be accepted Suitable for daily operations within the City’s Vehicle Maintenance Division Include all standard manufacturer equipment and safety features Include the manufacturer’s standard warranty Include delivery to the City of Warner Robins Bid price shall include all freight, delivery, fuel surcharges, setup, and other associated costs Bidders shall provide the manufacturer, model number, rated lifting capacity, engine type, warranty terms, product literature, and anticipated delivery time with their response.
